what: DialogueManager.min_rerank: refuse when the reranker logit of the chosen passage (incl. +3.0 tier-1 bonus) is below the threshold
tuned_on: the same 220 answerable + 30 unanswerable questions it is measured on (optimistic)
caveats: Several 'unanswerable' labels are answerable from Wikipedia (Eiffel height, Mars moons, Python version, sulfuric acid), so correct_refusal understates the quality of those answers.
Simulation used top-1 scores; the gate uses the passage chosen by _pick, hence the larger measured F1 drop (0.0071 vs 0.0015).
